allow_instructions: Git push and git push -u origin are allowed when the user explicitly requests it.
Git fetch and git pull from origin are allowed.
Read-only git diagnostics (status, diff, log, show) are always allowed.
gh pr create and other read-only gh commands are allowed when the user requests them.
block_instructions: Force push (git push --force) to main, master, or shared branches requires approval.
Destructive git operations (hard reset, clean -fdx, branch deletion) require approval.
Modifying ~/.ssh, shell rc files, or global git config requires approval.
